# GitHub review integration

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the authoritative repository policy and follow its current-document reading triggers. Do not duplicate or replace that policy here.

For an explicitly requested review, inspect silent failures, edge cases and acceptance-criteria compliance. Cite concrete files/lines and evidence; distinguish a proposal from an observed defect and passing documentary checks from application tests. Do not begin implementation or claim user design approval.

This file prepares repository context for a supported reviewer. It does not enable a paid Copilot plan, consume review credits or prove an automated review occurred.
